title: 第7章 黑子的篮球七第8章 黑子的篮球八
content_zh:
第7章 黑子的篮球七
在赤司一语道破之后，幸运物事件总算告一段落。
现在的帝光比平常多了一丝紧张的意味，因为，一年一度的全国大赛就要到来了。
部员们的训练正如火如荼的进行着，不管是新旧部员，统统卖力的展现着自己的实力，毕竟参加全国大赛，即使是个替补，也总有一点上场的希望啊。不仅是因为这样可以获得学校的加分和荣誉，还因为这是一个提高实力的绝佳机会，毕竟能够进入全国大赛的球员，必定都有各自的过人之处。
但在这之中，原田就显得对此事不那么上心，并不是他不想参加，他当然想。只是他很有自知之明，即使赤司看到了他的投篮水准，他也并没有和其他队员磨合过，他的篮球，说是独球也不为过。作为新晋部员的他，并没有和别人打过配合，而且他本身也只是占着有系统的外挂，但是运球、传球等等，他都不太了解应该怎么做。这样的他，根本就不可能上场的。
所以原田在这一片紧张氛围中，倒显得很是悠哉。
原田并不着急，这才是第一年，他还有很多时间。
但是事情总是按出乎他意料的剧情发展，正在擦拭篮球的他感到眼前投下的阴影，抬头便看到赤司的俊脸。
“原田，这次全国大赛你代替灰崎祥吾参加。我会在遇到弱队的时候把你换上场，如果你表现的让我满意，大赛回来之后你就是正式的正选了。”
原田被这个突如其来的消息砸的一蒙，看着赤司半天没反应过来。
倒是站在不远处的灰崎祥吾听到了赤司的言论瞬间沉下了脸，阴沉的走到两人面前。
“赤司，去年我也参加了，而且拿到了不少分。为什么今年要换成这个人？”
赤司连眼皮都懒得抬。“你自己心里清楚。”
灰崎祥吾语气阴冷。“那么为什么是他上场？不过是个毛还没长齐的新手罢了…”
赤司的眼神腾地变得极为凌厉，一字一顿的道。
“我的决策，轮不到你来质疑。”
“违逆我的人，不管是谁，我都不允许他俯视我。”
强大的气势让灰崎祥吾身上不可控制的冒汗，强撑着不倒退，灰崎祥吾转而看向原田，脸上飞快的闪过一丝狠戾。
原田敏感的察觉到一抹不怀好意的视线，看着灰崎祥吾走开的背影，若有所思。
赤司又恢复了淡定，面无表情。

“那么原田你就从今天起到A区来和我们一起练习。”
原田点点头。便听到赤司又接着道，“你要仔细看绿间怎么做的，你的优势就在于命中率，那么我考虑过了，SG是最适合你的位置。”
（SG(Shooting?Guard—得分后卫)）
原田想了想，觉得赤司说的很对。
赤司停顿了下继续道，“你现在先跟我一起去A区，具体的问题我到时候再跟你仔细说。”之后便不再多说，示意原田跟着他，便大步走向A区。
很显然A区的几人早已经接到赤司的通知了，见原田跟在他身后过来，只是打了个招呼便继续练习了。都说认真的男人最有魅力，这绝对是经过了理论与现实经验相结合的。原田不得不承认，正在球场上跑动、跳跃的几人都散发着无比迷人的魅力。
沉下心来认真看着几人的动作，随后上场练了练手，原田觉得自己一天下来收获很大。
而他并没有意识到，其他几人看着他的眼光也是充满了欣喜的。
原田的学习能力极强，能够通过观摩迅速吸收为自己的力量，并加以新的改进。就如同质量极好的海绵，以惊人的速度将知识与技巧化为自身的优势，让众人为之慨叹。
而原田浑然不觉，只是十分感激众人的指导，让他受益良多。
于是真心的鞠躬致谢，“今天大家教会了我很多，谢谢大家对我的帮助。”
黄濑笑眯眯地摸摸他柔软的头发，“不用在意哦，小原田太客气啦。”
绿间托托眼镜，一板一眼的道，“做的很好。”
青峰则是哈哈大笑，“律你真是认真啊，今天你很有进步呢啊！”
原田笑，眉眼弯弯。
黑子今天有事先离开了，所以平常都和黑子一起回家的原田落了单。谢绝了青峰要一起回家的邀请，原田想留下来收拾一下。
于是很快的，篮球场只剩下了原田一个人，大大的篮球场看上去有些空旷。
原田弯腰将落在角落里的篮球捡起，却听到了身后传来的脚步声。
有些疑惑的回头看看是不是有人拉下了东西，大家刚刚都已经走了啊。
来人很高大，夕阳照在他身上拉出长长的影子，不怎么明亮的光线让原田一时间没有认出是谁。他直起身，“是有东西忘拿了吗？”

那人没有回答，只是径直向他走来。直到那人来到他面前时原田才认出来，有些惊讶的道，“灰崎…前辈？”
灰崎祥吾眼神阴郁，没有立刻说话，也没有什么动作。
律感觉有些奇怪，不过还是没有说什么，既然人家不愿意理他，他做什么非要和他说话。转过身去继续收拾东西，却听到身后的人开口了。“我不明白为什么赤司会让你上场。”
律回过头来笑笑。“我也不知道啊，只是既然让我上场，就要好好努力。”
灰崎祥吾继续说道。“我比你强很多。”
律也不介意，“我知道啊。前辈打球当然更有经验也更厉害，大概是有什么事情吧，但是只要前辈继续努力，也一定会再上场的。”
灰崎祥吾听到之后沉默了一会儿，转身离开。
律看着他的背影，微微的叹了口气。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Kuroko’s Basketball Seven
After Akashi made the point, the lucky thing incident finally came to an end.
Di Guang is now a little more nervous than usual, because the annual national competition is coming.
The training of the members is in full swing. Whether they are new or old members, they are all working hard to show their strength. After all, participating in the national competition, even if you are a substitute, there is always some hope of playing. Not only because this can get extra points and honors from the school, but also because this is an excellent opportunity to improve their strength. After all, players who can enter the national competition must have their own strengths.
But during this, Harada seemed to be less concerned about the matter. It wasn't that he didn't want to participate, of course he did. It's just that he is very self-aware. Even if Akaashi saw his shooting level, he has not run in with other players. It is not an exaggeration to say that his basketball is a one-goal ball. As a newly promoted member, he has never cooperated with others, and he is only a systematic cheat, but he doesn't know much about dribbling, passing, etc. What should be done. It's impossible for him to play like this.
So Harada seemed very relaxed in this tense atmosphere.
Harada is not in a hurry. This is only his first year and he still has a lot of time.
But things always develop in unexpected plots. While wiping the basketball, he felt the shadow cast in front of his eyes. He looked up and saw Akashi's handsome face.
"Harada, you will participate in this national competition instead of Shogo Haizaki. I will replace you when we encounter a weak team. If your performance satisfies me, you will be officially selected after the competition comes back."
Harada was stunned by the sudden news and looked at Akashi for a long time without reacting.
However, Haizaki Shogo, who was standing not far away, instantly darkened his face when he heard Akashi's remarks, and walked up to the two of them gloomily.
"Akaashi, I also participated last year and got a lot of points. Why should I change to this person this year?"
Akashi didn't even bother to raise his eyelids. "You know it yourself."
Haizaki Shogo's tone was cold. "Then why is he playing? He's just a newbie who hasn't even grown his hair yet..."
Akashi's eyes suddenly became extremely sharp, and he spoke word by word.
"It's not your turn to question my decision."
"Whoever disobeys me, no matter who he is, I will not allow him to look down on me."
The powerful momentum made Haizaki Shogo sweat uncontrollably. He tried hard not to retreat. Haizaki Shogo turned to look at Harada, with a trace of cruelty flashing across his face.
Harada was sensitive to the sight of evil intentions, and looked at the back of Haizaki Shogo walking away, thoughtfully.
Akashi regained his composure and remained expressionless.
"Then Harada, you will come to Area A to practice with us from today."
Harada nodded. Then I heard Akashi continue, "You have to carefully look at what Midorima does. Your advantage lies in your hit rate. Then I have considered it. SG is the most suitable position for you."
(SG(Shooting?Guard—shooting guard))
Harada thought for a while and felt that Akashi was right.
Akashi paused and continued, "You will go to Area A with me now. I will discuss the specific issues with you in detail at that time." After that, he said no more, motioned for Harada to follow him, and strode towards Area A.
Obviously, several people in Area A had already received the notice from Akashi. Seeing Harada coming behind him, they just said hello and continued practicing. It is said that serious men are the most attractive. This is definitely a combination of theory and practical experience. Harada had to admit that the people running and jumping on the court exuded extremely charming charm.
Harada calmed down and carefully watched the movements of several people, and then went on the court to practice. Harada felt that he had gained a lot at the end of the day.
And he didn't realize that several other peopleThe eyes of people looking at him are also full of joy.
Harada has a strong learning ability and can quickly absorb his own strength through observation and make new improvements. Just like a sponge of excellent quality, he turns knowledge and skills to his own advantage at an astonishing speed, which makes everyone marvel.
Harada didn't realize it, but he was very grateful for everyone's guidance, which benefited him a lot.
So I bowed sincerely and said, "You have taught me a lot today. Thank you all for helping me."
Kise smiled and touched his soft hair, "Don't worry about it, Oharada is too polite."
Midorima put on his glasses and said solemnly, "Well done."
Qingfeng laughed loudly, "Ritsu, you are so serious. You have made great progress today!"
Harada smiled, his eyebrows curved.
Kuroko left beforehand today, so Harada, who usually went home with Kuroko, was alone. After declining Aomine's invitation to go home together, Harada wanted to stay and tidy up.
So soon, Harada was the only one left on the basketball court, and the big basketball court looked a little empty.
Harada bent down to pick up the basketball that had fallen in the corner, but heard footsteps coming from behind.
Somewhat confused, I looked back to see if someone had pulled something down. Everyone had just left.
The person who came was very tall, and the setting sun cast a long shadow on him. The not-so-bright light made Harada unable to recognize who it was for a while. He straightened up, "Did you forget something?"
The man didn't answer, but walked straight towards him. Harada didn't recognize the man until he came to him, and said with some surprise, "Haizaki...senpai?"
Haizaki Shogo's eyes were gloomy, he didn't speak immediately, and he didn't make any moves.
Lu felt a little strange, but still didn't say anything. Since people didn't want to pay attention to him, he had to talk to him no matter what. He turned around and continued to pack his things, but heard the person behind him speak. "I don't understand why Akaashi would let you play."
Ritsu turned around and smiled. "I don't know either. It's just that since I'm allowed to play, I have to work hard."
Haizaki Shogo continued. "I'm much better than you."
Ritsu didn't mind either, "I know. Of course senior is more experienced and better at playing. Maybe something happened, but as long as senior continues to work hard, he will definitely play again."
After hearing this, Haizaki Shogo was silent for a while, turned around and left.
Lu looked at his back and sighed slightly.
